pages.summary: The app designer: lay out an app's window with the mouse, and get its class written.
body: Components are added from the palette (a click, or a drag onto the window), moved and resized with the mouse or the arrow keys, and set in the inspector, where a callback gets its name and code. Save writes `Name.m` in the current folder, a class derived from `matlab.apps.AppBase` (with the layout kept in a comment at its end, so the designer can open it again); Run saves and runs it; Code opens the file in the Editor, where the callbacks can be written too. The designer writes the rest of the class again each time, so changes made outside the callbacks are not kept.
syntax: The app in `Name.m`, or a new one of that name.

examples.title: A new app of a name
examples.intro: Opens the designer beside the Editor; nothing is written until Save.

notes: To go back from the code to the layout: Design App on the Editor's tab with the app's file open, or Open in App Designer on the file in the Current Folder.

pages.summary: A window for an app: no number, its handle hidden, no menus or tools.
body: Components, panels, grid layouts and `uiaxes` go in it. Its `Position` is in pixels, `[left bottom width height]`. A uifigure is never the current figure, so plotting into it needs the axes given: `plot(ax, ...)`.

examples.title: A small window with three components

pages.summary: A push button, or a state button that stays pressed.
body: A push button runs its `ButtonPushedFcn` when pushed; a state button (`'state'`) toggles its `Value` between true and false and runs its `ValueChangedFcn`. `Text`, `Icon` and `IconAlignment` set its face.

examples.title: Two kinds of button

pages.summary: Text in an app: a label, a field to type in (text or a number), and a field of several lines.
body: A numeric field (`uieditfield(parent, 'numeric')`) keeps its `Value` a number within `Limits`, shown by `ValueDisplayFormat`: a number typed outside the limits is not taken, and one set from code is an error. `ValueChangedFcn` runs when the typing is done (Enter, or leaving the field), and `ValueChangingFcn` as a text field is typed in. A text area's `Value` is a column cell of its lines.

examples.title: A small form
examples.output:
'Value' must be within the Limits [0 500].
ans =

   120

controls.value:
Core taken at noon.
Water at 3 m.

pages.summary: Lists to choose from: one that opens to choose one item, and one that shows its items.
body: `Items` are the texts shown. `Value` is the chosen item, or its element of `ItemsData` when that is set. A list box takes several with `'Multiselect', 'on'` (its `Value` is then a cell); a drop-down with `'Editable', 'on'` also takes typed text.

examples.title: Chosen by text or by data

pages.summary: A check box, and a switch between two items.
body: A check box's `Value` is true or false. A switch (slider, `'rocker'` or `'toggle'`) has two `Items`, `Off` and `On` unless given, and its `Value` is one of them. Both run `ValueChangedFcn` when changed.

examples.title: On and off

pages.summary: Numbers chosen with the mouse: a slider, a field with arrows, and a knob.
body: All three keep their `Value` within `Limits`. A slider has `MajorTicks` and `MajorTickLabels`; its `ValueChangingFcn` runs as it is dragged and `ValueChangedFcn` when it is let go. A spinner steps by `Step`. A knob turns continuously, or among `Items` when `'discrete'`.

examples.title: Three ways to set a number

pages.summary: Indicators: a gauge showing a value, and a lamp of a colour.
body: A gauge is `'circular'` unless given (also `'linear'`, `'ninetydegree'`, `'semicircular'`); `ScaleColors` with `ScaleColorLimits` colour parts of its scale. A lamp shows a `Color`, for a state such as ready or failed.

examples.title: A reading and a warning

pages.summary: Buttons in a button group, one chosen at a time.
body: Made in a `uibuttongroup`: choosing a radio button clears the group's others, and pressing a toggle button releases them. The group's `SelectedObject` is the chosen one, and its `SelectionChangedFcn` runs with `OldValue` and `NewValue` when the choice changes.

examples.title: One of three, twice

pages.summary: A picture in an app, and a link.
body: An image's `ImageSource` is a file name or an RGB array; `ScaleMethod` (`'fit'` unless given, or `'fill'`, `'none'`, `'scaledown'`, `'stretch'`) fits it into its `Position`, and `ImageClickedFcn` runs when it is clicked. A hyperlink shows `Text` and opens its `URL` when clicked.

examples.title: A picture made in code, and a link

pages.summary: Rows and columns that place the components put in them, filling the parent.
body: `RowHeight` and `ColumnWidth` are pixels, `'fit'` (as much as the content needs), or weights such as `'1x'` and `'2x'` that share what is left; `Padding` and `RowSpacing`, `ColumnSpacing` set the gaps. A component's `Layout.Row` and `Layout.Column` (a number, or `[first last]` to span) say where it goes; without them it takes the next free cell. When the window is resized, the grid follows.

examples.title: A form that keeps its shape

body: Plotting functions draw into them when given them: `plot(ax, x, y)`, `title(ax, '...')`, `xlabel(ax, '...')`, since a uifigure is never the current figure. Their `Position` is the box of the plot itself; the tick labels, axis labels and title go outside it, so leave room around it.
syntax: Axes in a uifigure or a container.

examples.title: A plot in an app's window

pages.summary: A message in an app's window, and a question whose chosen option is returned.
body: `uialert` shows a message with an OK button, an icon (`'error'` unless given; `'warning'`, `'info'`, `'success'`, `'none'`), and goes on at once. `uiconfirm` waits until an option is chosen and returns it: `OK` and `Cancel` unless `'Options'` gives up to three; `'DefaultOption'` and `'CancelOption'` say which Enter and Escape pick, and `CloseFcn` runs when it closes.

examples.title: A message
examples.code:
fig = uifigure('Position', [100 100 360 200]);
uialert(fig, 'The file could not be read.', 'Open', 'Icon', 'warning');

string: The file could not be read.

examples.title: A question
examples.intro: Run, it waits for a choice. The stored output came without one, which counts as the cancel option (the last, unless 'CancelOption' says).
examples.code:
fig = uifigure('Position', [100 100 360 200]);
choice = uiconfirm(fig, 'Save the changes?', 'Close', 'Options', {'Save', 'Discard', 'Cancel'})

pages.summary: A progress bar for a long task, over an app's window.
body: Its `Value` (0 to 1) and `Message` are set by the program as the work goes on; `close(d)` removes it. `'Indeterminate', 'on'` shows work without a measure of how much is done.

examples.title: A loop that reports

pages.summary: What an app's class uses to tie its components, window and startup to itself.
body: An app is a class derived from `matlab.apps.AppBase`, as the app designer writes it. `createCallbackFcn(app, @method, true)` gives a component a callback that calls the app's own method with the app and the event data; `registerApp(app, app.UIFigure)` ties the app to its window, so that closing the window deletes the app; `runStartupFcn(app, @startupFcn)` runs the startup method once the window is made.
syntax: A callback that calls a method of the app.
The app tied to its window.

examples.title: A converter, as the designer would write it
examples.intro: The class is written to its file here so that the example runs on its own. The callback is then called as a change of the field would call it.
examples.code:
lines = {
    'classdef Converter < matlab.apps.AppBase'
    '    properties (Access = public)'
    '        UIFigure      matlab.ui.Figure'
    '        CelsiusField  matlab.ui.control.NumericEditField'
    '        Result        matlab.ui.control.Label'
    '    end'
    '    methods (Access = private)'
    '        function startupFcn(app)'
    '            app.CelsiusField.Value = 20;'
    '            show(app)'
    '        end'
    '        function CelsiusChanged(app, event)'
    '            show(app)'
    '        end'
    '        function show(app)'
    '            app.Result.Text = sprintf(''%g °F'', app.CelsiusField.Value*9/5 + 32);'
    '        end'
    '        function createComponents(app)'
    '            app.UIFigure = uifigure(''Position'', [100 100 260 110], ''Name'', ''Converter'');'
    '            uilabel(app.UIFigure, ''Text'', ''°C'', ''Position'', [20 60 30 22]);'
    '            app.CelsiusField = uieditfield(app.UIFigure, ''numeric'', ''Position'', [50 60 80 22]);'
    '            app.CelsiusField.ValueChangedFcn = createCallbackFcn(app, @CelsiusChanged, true);'
    '            app.Result = uilabel(app.UIFigure, ''Position'', [150 60 100 22]);'
    '        end'
    '    end'
    '    methods (Access = public)'
    '        function app = Converter'
    '            createComponents(app)'
    '            registerApp(app, app.UIFigure)'
    '            runStartupFcn(app, @startupFcn)'
    '        end'
    '        function delete(app)'
    '            delete(app.UIFigure)'
    '        end'
    '    end'
    'end'};
fid = fopen('Converter.m', 'w');
fprintf(fid, '%s\n', lines{:});
fclose(fid);
app = Converter;
app.Result.Text
app.CelsiusField.Value = 100;
cb = app.CelsiusField.ValueChangedFcn;
cb(app.CelsiusField, []);
app.Result.Text
